entities.summary: Abu Abd Allah Muhammad ibn al-Husayn Ibn al-Kattani al-Madhiji (951–1029), sometimes nicknamed "al-Mutatabbib", was a well-known Arab scholar, philosopher, physician, astrologer, man of letters, and poet.
